subject: STOP statement
notes: cite.py --check 14.9.42.4 GR4 -> OK. No status phrase => no SetExitStatus emitted, exit stays 0 (p1; test InlineData 'STOP RUN.' 0). Adversarial: a CALLed (non-main) program executing 'GOBACK WITH ERROR STATUS 5' then the main's plain 'STOP RUN.' (probe q2) -> exit 0, so a non-main status phrase does not leak into GR4's normal indication. The implementor-defined error-termination mechanism is optional (Annex A item 193); none is provided, which is permitted. Abnormal termination (fatal EC) is §14.6.12, not this rule. [editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 (STOP RUN is in every edition; §14.9.42 of the 2023 text)]
